decisions.reason: After several years the trial period is over, but as a close-to-core printer platform in a growing firm it likely remains near or above aspiration levels and still merits retention.

Because this is a more specialized hardware niche and its later visibility appears weaker, management would treat it as more likely below aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger core and new-development uses.
As a low-cost complementary app and successor to an earlier solution, it supports the firm's traceability direction and can be carried even if direct returns are only moderate.
Inline code verification fits the firm's move toward compliance and end-to-end traceability, so it is likely performing favorably enough relative to aspirations to retain.
Print layout software is strategically related but easier to fold into other offerings, so if standalone uptake has stayed only middling management would redeploy the resources.
